content.short: Unleash NFTs is an NFT analytics and forensics platform launched in 2020, offering visualizations to analyze NFT data, trade volume authenticity, and pricing.
content.description: Unleash NFTs is a multi-chain NFT analytics and forensics platform that supports Avalanche, Ethereum, Polygon, and Solana. Launched in 2020, it provides rich data visualizations to help you decide when to buy, sell, or hold NFTs, while enabling you to understand the market capitalization and performance of NFT collections. It also helps distinguish genuine from fake trade volume and determine fair prices and originality for NFTs.
